metadata.description: Growth agents and campaign skills from the KPay Digital Growth OS. Install the plugin for the tools alone; clone the repo if you want the full OS with its Tasks, Knowledge and memory layers.

plugins.name: growth-toolkit
plugins.description: Seven growth role agents (paid media, content/SEO, lifecycle, web/CRO, analytics, growth lead, creative reviewer) plus campaign, content, email, experiment, channel-review, reporting, research-synthesis and eval skills.
